title: Wearables — fashion and accessories
covers: anything worn or carried: clothing (dresses, tops, jackets, coats, knitwear, jeans, skirts), bags (handbags, purses, totes, crossbody, clutches, backpacks, wallets), shoes, jewellery (earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets), watches, sunglasses and glasses, hats, scarves, belts, hair accessories

shots.direction: The model wearing or holding the product in the ad's place — framed so the whole product reads clearly (full or three-quarter length for clothing, medium for bags and accessories, close for jewellery — for earrings a close portrait with the ear and jaw in frame, both earrings at their real size), the model mid-movement or in a confident pose, looking toward the camera.
